name: snippets-free
description: コピペして使えるフロントエンドのパーツ集

scripts.check: S=0; bash tools/check-paths.sh . || S=$?; bash tools/check-design.sh . || S=$?; node tools/check-links.mjs || S=$?; node tools/check-markers.mjs || S=$?; node tools/check-verification.mjs || S=$?; node tools/check-notation.mjs || S=$?; exit $S
scripts.check:release: S=0; npm run --silent check || S=$?; node tools/check-markers.mjs . --require-embedded || S=$?; node tools/check-verification.mjs . --require-verified || S=$?; exit $S
